sentences.text: Why did pirates fly black flags?
To say: we will kill you all?
Pirates often crept close under a friendly flag, then ran up the black one.
It meant: give up now, and we show mercy.
Some ships gave up at the very sight.
Fight back, and a red flag might follow: no mercy.
The black flag was meant to win the treasure without a fight.
One crew had no black flag, so they hoisted a dirty tarpaulin and fired a gun.

describe: A warm, dry, slightly smug English gentleman in his fifties, telling a strange true story to a friend. Clear, unhurried, natural pauses, a hint of amusement.
